extracted.intended_audience: punsters, potential contestants, and general public/attendees of the O. Henry Museum Pun-Off World Championships
extracted.subtask_description: Information and practical requirements for attending or entering the O. Henry Museum Pun-Off World Championships (spoken-word pun competition and associated event activities). Covers contest offerings, logistics, accessibility, and attendee guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admission: free/no ticket required
rubrics_metrics.description: The event is free to the public and no ticket is required for admission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Event date/time and location are listed (May 9, 2026, 10:00am–6:00pm at Brush Square Park).

rubrics_metrics.name: Contests offered: Punniest of Show and Punslingers
rubrics_metrics.description: The Pun-Off features two separate live contests: Punniest of Show and Punslingers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contestants may enter either or both contests; the competition is an internationally renowned spoken word contest focused on the art of the pun.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event format/genre: spoken-word pun competition
rubrics_metrics.description: An internationally renowned spoken word competition focused on the art of the pun, held in honor of William Sydney Porter (O. Henry).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is one of Austin’s oldest 'weird' events and a battle of wit and wordplay; background context may inform performance and audience expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Family-friendly event
rubrics_metrics.description: This is a family-friendly outdoor event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attendees are encouraged to bring blankets, lawn chairs, coolers, and snacks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility / ADA compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act; reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For assistance contact (512) 974-3917 or Relay Texas 7-1-1. For language interpreter requests call Austin 3-1-1 or 512-974-2000.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parking and validation
rubrics_metrics.description: Street parking is limited, but many public parking garages are located near Brush Square.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brush Square Museums will validate parking for up to 2 hours at the Austin Convention Center parking garage at 601 East 5th St.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional event offerings / fundraising
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to the competitions, the event includes live music by Kathleen Turner Overdrive, a silent auction, shaved ice, and t-shirt sales to benefit the O. Henry Museum.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These activities supplement the contests and serve as museum fundraising/visitor attractions.

rubrics_metrics.name: O. Henry Museum hours and context
rubrics_metrics.description: The O. Henry Museum (the historic Queen Anne-style cottage where William Sydney Porter lived in the 1890s) is free and open to the public 12pm–5pm, Weds.–Sun.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Pun-Off is held behind the museum at Brush Square Park and celebrates O. Henry’s legacy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact / assistance phone numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact information provided for assistance and general information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For assistance call (512) 974-3917 or Relay Texas 7-1-1. For more info or interpreter requests call Austin 3-1-1 or 512-974-2000. Page footer lists 512-974-1398.
